decorators.absent: Bash has no decorator, annotation or attribute syntax.

takes_fn.absent: Bash functions are not values: a parameter holds a string, and calls are recorded only to functions the file defines (calls.known_only).

returns_fn.absent: Bash functions return an exit status, never a function.

param_calls.absent: Calls are recorded only to functions the file defines (calls.known_only), so a call through a positional parameter ("$1" x) cannot be told apart from a command.

table_calls.absent: Bash arrays hold strings; ${T[k]} x runs a command by name, which calls.known_only does not record.

fn_tables.absent: Bash has no function values: an array holds strings, and running ${T[k]} calls a command by name.

datatypes.absent: Bash has no data types: every value is a string, and arrays hold strings.
